messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "coughing up blood"
set: ["coughing up blood", "seek emergency medical attention for coughing up blood", "stop using and call doctor at once if coughing up blood", "monitor for blood pressure changes when standing up", "do not double up to catch up", "raise blood sugar and your doses may need to go up", "blood", "up to 5 weeks", "up to 24 hours", "hard to wake up", "adrenal glands not caught up", "particularly true when stand up", "blood clot", "blood clotting", "blood cancer", "blood levels"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
